facts.text: RunzeSyringePump opens a pyserial link in its constructor and controls one addressed pump
The constructor takes port, address, max_volume (default 25.0) and mode; max_volume is a constructor option
The constructor sets total_steps and total_steps_vel to 6000
The constructor opens Serial(baudrate=9600, port=port)
send_command writes the command, sleeps 0.05 s and reads until a newline
The constructor catches OSError and SerialException and stores the port string in hardware_interface instead of raising
A command is framed as /<address><command><R?>\r\n; R is appended unless the command contains '?'
The status query Q maps a backtick reply to Idle and every other reply to Busy
Position is computed as pos_step / total_steps * max_volume
set_position moves to an absolute volume documented in mL; its max_velocity is documented in ml/s
pull_plunger and push_plunger move a fixed volume documented in mL
set_max_velocity converts the velocity to an integer pulse frequency (velocity / max_volume * total_steps_vel), caps it at 6000 and runs the V command
get_max_velocity converts the pulse frequency back with pulse_freq / total_steps_vel * max_volume
_adjust_total_steps would set total_steps to 6000 in Normal mode and 48000 otherwise, and total_steps_vel to 48000 in AccuratePosVel and 6000 otherwise
set_mode, which would set the mode and call _adjust_total_steps, is commented out
_run sends the command and polls get_status every 0.5 s until Idle, holding _run_lock for the whole operation
stop_operation runs the T command through _run
_query holds only _query_lock while it frames and sends one command and reads its reply
get_valve_position queries ?6 and returns the second character upper-cased
query_command_buffer_status, query_backlash_position, query_aux_input_status_1, query_aux_input_status_2 and query_software_version query the commands ?10, ?12, ?13, ?14 and ?23
close sets _closing and closes hardware_interface

operator_required.name: position
operator_required.reason: the plunger travel is read as pos_step / total_steps * max_volume (runze_backbone.py:294-298) and max_volume is a constructor option; no text of the clone states the travel range, so the site sets it

operator_required.name: max_velocity
operator_required.reason: the clone converts a velocity in mL/s to a pulse frequency (runze_backbone.py:225-229) but states no numeric velocity or flow range; the site sets the permitted range of its syringe and tubing

operator_required.name: pump
operator_required.reason: the clone has no timed run: it pushes or pulls a volume and polls until Idle (runze_backbone.py:152-164, 321-345), so the duration is the site's bound on one converted volume

operator_required.name: pump
operator_required.reason: pump and tubing limits are declared per binding

operator_required.name: pump
operator_required.reason: the usable volume depends on the installed syringe; max_volume is a constructor option (runze_backbone.py:81-85), not a bound stated by the clone, so the site sets the range of its syringe

safe_state.description: pump stopped by the protocol T command of stop_operation and confirmed Idle by the Q status query; the valve and plunger hold their last positions, bytes already queued in the serial driver are not flushed, and a status reply other than the idle byte leaves the stop unconfirmed (SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED)
